decision_provenance: Explicit template nonnegative-i64-v1 under scalar-wrapping-v1; input domain is all i64.

requirements.text: For an integer x, return x if x is nonnegative, and return zero otherwise.
requirements.source_excerpt: For an integer x, return x if x is nonnegative, and return zero otherwise.
assumptions: Integer is signed wrapping i64 by the versioned template domain.
